title: Do Attribution Graphs for Factual Recall Replicate Across Model Families?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Validating attribution graphs as model-agnostic rather than Claude-specific is essential for their adoption as a general safety tool. Replication across model families directly increases trust in the methodology for safety auditing.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Running circuit-tracer on three different model families (Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B, Pythia-6.9B) requires substantial compute and technical skill. Loading and running multiple large models is challenging on medium compute. Cross-model comparison adds analytical complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three model families, 20 prompts each, structural comparison of attribution graphs. Even with tooling support, the three-model design is extensive. Would need to be reduced to 2 models and fewer prompts to fit in 30 hours.
